headword: {社内恋愛|しゃないれんあい}

definitions.explanation: a romantic relationship between colleagues at the same company

examples.japanese: {社内恋愛|しゃないれんあい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
{社内恋愛|しゃないれんあい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧バレて⟦{気|き}まずい→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧。
examples.english: Our office romance was discovered and it's awkward.

examples.japanese: {社内恋愛|しゃないれんあい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many couples who start with an office romance end up getting married.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧ (within the company) + ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧ (romantic love)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Common topic in Japanese dramas and manga
- Some companies have formal or informal policies against it
- Can be complicated by hierarchical relationships (⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧/⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧)

CONCERNS:
- Impact on work performance
- Favoritism perceptions
- Awkwardness if relationship ends
- Power imbalance issues
